*The year 193X.
The Japanese Empire has created a new breed of super-soldiers in the name of national defense.*
*The Stryker System!
Bionic technology designed by Dr. Ichimonji Soichiro to make men stronger, faster!*
*Their official name: the Imperial All-Terrain Strike Support Rangers. 
Super-soldiers designed to protect the borders of the Japanese Empire.*
*Soldiers of justice, staking their lives in battle to protect Mother Japan from the wicked Balbora Empire!*
*These bionic soldiers -- the Strykers -- are granted various powers through the Stryker Drives!*
*The technology that joins the soldier to these Drives is known as the Stryker System!!*
*JPNS-002: 'Stryker Drive: Shusui'*
*Shusui, the Singing Sword! Channels high-voltage electrical current into a blade for the wielder!*
*JPNS-003: 'Stryker Drive: Hyaku-shiki'*
*The 'Type 100' Hyaku-shiki. Compresses plasma around the fist, lending it punching power equivalent to a heavy tank gun!!*
*JPNS-004: 'Stryker Drive: Shinden'*

*JPNS-005: 'Stryker Drive: Tenrai'*
*Tenrai, the 'Heavenly Thunder.' A fearsome technique that launches blasts of plasma at the enemy. Its output can even be adjusted and set to stun!*
*JPNS-009: 'Stryker Drive: Senden'*
*'Flash Lightning' Senden. Increases the transmission of electric signals across the body's synapses to push muscle activity to its peak.*

*Stryker Zero stands bravely against the encroaching evil of the Balbora Empire. His story... begins now!!*

*I sighed and closed the book.*
*I'd read this comic... I don't even know how many times. I gazed down at the cover.*

*That's right! I promised to show Haruna the Stryker Equipment I made!*

Yamato: When I grow up, I'm gonna be a real superhero! The kind who beats up all the bad guys!
Haruna: I know you will! I like you best when you talk like that, Yamato-kun!
*Haruna's the only one who doesn't laugh at my dream of becoming a hero someday.*
Yamato: Okay! I'm off!

Hiromi: Oh my, Yamato! Are you playing Dengeki Stryker again?

Yamato: Mom, when I grow up, I'm gonna be a real superhero! Then I'll protect you and dad, for sure!

*Faster, faster! To the big empty lot where we always meet!*
*Haruna's waiting for me! There's not a moment to lose!*

Haruna: Hey, give it... give it back!

*The cars were of a modern make, like nothing I'd seen before. The telephone poles were made of concrete.*

Hiromi: Yamato! I told you not to stay out so late! It's dinner time. We need to get home!

Hiromi: Let's go home, now. I made your favorite, curry rice!

Hiromi: Oh, Yamato. You really do like playing hero. Speaking of which, the lady next door...
*My uniform and Stryker units were inside my bag... but they were too big for me. I couldn't use them with my body as it was.*
Hiromi: Come on now, pay attention! This isn't like you, Yamato. Is something wrong?
Stryker Zero: N-No, nothing... nothing of interest to report.

*But even then, he did not come.*
*Their innocent promise was left unkept.*
*Time passed... and so our story begins.*

*I was flying. The freezing winds of the stratosphere battered my face, but to a man of my attributes, it was but a pleasant chill.*
*Flight was one of the basic functions of the Stryker System.*
*Using the electric field between the emitter and the collector, the Stryker System channels atmosphere downwards, creating an ionic wind on which to glide.*
*When combined with the extremely high electric energy of the Stryker System, this allows for high-speed flight.*

*The boy waved to him, then ran down the shrine's steps.*
*With the boy gone, a silence returned to the area. Yamato watched the boy go, then turned to the empty shrine grounds, as if facing someone.*
Yamato: ...That boy is going to fight with his own power now.
Yamato: There's no one here for you to make a contract with. Give it up, Memory Collector.
*In front of his eyes stood a single old man.*
Memory Collector: Ho ho... What a pity. You've cut me off once again.
Yamato: And I'll do it again and again. Your little hobby is a plague on this world.
Memory Collector: Hmm... Well, I'll be off, then. But I'm going to be back, you know? For as long as people seek me out...
Yamato: And I'll be back, too. People aren't as weak as you think they are.
Yamato: Because every person out there, if they want to... just as long as they want to... they can become a superhero.
Memory Collector: ...I'll keep that in mind. Ho ho ho...
*The man's silhouette began to fade. Before long, he was completely gone.*
*Yamato shrugged and began to walk down the stairs, away from the shrine.*
*The moon was high in the sky, casting Yamato in its light. Thoughts racing through his mind, he looked up to that shining orb of gold, and whispered.*
Yamato: They can become a superhero. Isn't that right... Stryker?
*And so continued the story of the one who inherited the mantle of justice. But that is a tale for another time.*
================================================================================
*Children of elementary school age were playing on the strip of green.*
*Killing time on their way back from school, I guessed. They had piled their backpacks on the hillside.*
Jack: A tranquil scene.
Yamato: Yes, it is...
*I stopped, and turned my eyes to the cherry blossom trees where I had sat with Rin.*
Jack: It appears Rin-dono was of great service to you, My Liege.
Yamato: Yes, I'm grateful to her. ...And to her family.
Jack: The sight of you two sleeping peacefully 'neath the trees... 'twas a vision to be treasured.
Yamato: Wait a moment. Why do you know about that?
Jack: 'tis ever my duty to remain at My Liege's side. I watched over My Liege all the night through.
Yamato: I truly did let down my guard, then... How could I be so reckless?
Jack: All must relax, from time to time. Even I take mine emoluments, at times...
Jack: Ah!
*Jack quickly cut himself off. ...Emoluments?*
*Now that I thought about it, we had ended up a little short on snacks...*
*I was about to give him a talking to, but before I could speak, he spoke, first.*
================================================================================
*As she did, someone else took her place and stood beside our table.*
Haruna: G-good morning, Yamato-kun...
Yamato: Good morning.
*Curious... Haruna seemed rather stiff, this morning. I wondered if something had happened to her.*
Jack: Well, well, Haruna-dono! 'tis a coincidence, to find you here this morn.
Haruna: Y-yes. I thought I'd have a cup of coffee to wake me up...
Sayaka: This was no coincidence. Haruna just came because--
Haruna: S-stop it! Sayaka-chan...
*Haruna plopped down across from me. Ichimonji brought us our coffee.*
*I slurped the jet black liquid. Haruna leaned in to address me privately.*
Haruna: Umm... Listen... About the flower-viewing party...
Yamato: ...hmm?
Haruna: Oh... um, it's nothing!
*She cut off, seeming a little depressed. What on Earth was going on?*
Yamato: From your behavior, it is hard to accept it as nothing.
Haruna: ...It just... It seems like... you and Rin-chan have gotten really close... Yamato-kun...
Yamato: Yes. She was a great help to me, after all.
Haruna: Is that... all it is?
Yamato: I'm not sure what you're implying, but that is definitely the extent of the matter.
Haruna: Oh... really? Thank goodness!
*Haruna took my stone-faced answer with a smile that bloomed across her face.*
*Women are difficult creatures to understand.*
Sayaka: Hehehe...
Yamato: W-what?! How long have you been standing there?!
Sayaka: Haruna's been jealous for so long.
Yamato: I don't understand what you mean. She doesn't seem zealous to me, at all.
Haruna: Oh, geez... It's n-nothing, I told you!
*I realized that my headache was gone. Was it because the exchange with the others had distracted me?*
================================================================================
Yamato: ...Not everything was a lie.
Haruna: ...What?
Yamato: It wasn't all a lie! Not the days I spent at school, not the days I spent fighting to defend the city!
*I grabbed Haruna's shoulders and looked straight into her face.*
Yamato: The lunch that you made for me... The days we spent flower-viewing with our friends... They're not a lie! They're real!
Haruna: ...Yamato-kun.
Yamato: I was given memories of being a soldier.
Yamato: I took my orders as absolute and worked toward national defense without regard for anything else.
Yamato: But it turns out those orders never existed...
Yamato: But...
Yamato: Even so, the things I've done are not a lie. The days I've spent with you are not a lie!
Haruna: ...Yes... Yes, you're right...
*Haruna gave a small nod. I emphatically returned it.*
Yamato: It's true. No matter where you come from, you make your own decisions.
Yamato: And my decision is... to defend you, and to defend this city!
Yamato: As a superhero - as Dengeki Stryker!
*It was the first time I had ever said the name - Dengeki Stryker. The hero's name.*
*The words set my blood rushing. My still heart began to beat again.*
Yamato: If nothing else, I know this feeling is real.
Haruna: But I'm just...!
Yamato: You aren't going to disappear. The time has come. I will give my life to protect you.
Haruna: ...That makes me so happy.
*Haruna couldn't say anything else, but just looked at me in silence.*
*New tears began to run down her cheeks. She hugged me as tightly as she could.*
Haruna: Yamato-kun...!
*She clung to me. I felt her tears fall against my chest.*
*I returned her embrace, pouring all my pain into the act of stroking her hair.*
Yamato: ...Don't worry. You're a dear friend. I don't intend to lose you this easily.
Haruna: ...Ah? What... was that?
Yamato: I don't intend to lose you this easily?
Haruna: ...Before that.
Yamato: You're a dear friend.
Haruna: Friend... A friend...
*Haruna looked at me again, as if at a loss for words.*
Haruna: Ah... ahaha! Th-that's right... We're friends. Just friends.
Yamato: What's the matter?
Haruna: ...That's just the kind of person you are, Yamato-kun.
Yamato: What are you talking about?
Haruna: For a minute, I was hoping... but, yes. We should be friends first! That's right.
Yamato: What do you mean, first? We're already friends.
Haruna: Yes... that's true.
*Haruna gave me a slightly melancholic smile.*
Haruna: But... I'm glad. You're the same person you always were.
Yamato: Yes. Anyway, I'll do what I can.
*Haruna had stopped crying. I placed my hands on her shoulders and looked into her eyes with new determination.*
================================================================================
Haruna: Good luck... Yamato-kun...
*At last, the Taizan drive snapped into place.*
*That was it. I felt a massive swelling of power from the Stryker Unit. My near-dead body overflowed once again with vitality.*
Yamato: Rrrgh, rrrrrrrrrrrrrgh!!
*I began to howl as the overwhelming power ran through me. I balled up my fists and stood...*
Haruna: ...Thank goodness.
*A smile of relief appeared on Haruna's face as I stood.*
Yamato: You wait here, Haruna! Leave this to me... You stay out of danger!
Haruna: I will... Yamato-kun...
*There were tears in her eyes, possibly from relief. I smiled, to assure her that everything was alright.*
Haruna: Go out there and win, Yamato-kun.
Yamato: I will!! Dengeki Stryker, Yuuki Yamato... heading out!
*I gave her a final nod in thanks. Then, concentrating my building emotions into my fists, I flew back at Mirror.*

Sayaka: Don't worry, Rin. You still have me.... You still have us.
*Sayaka was looking at the figure of Haruna, scarf wrapped around her neck, waving at the two of them.*
Sayaka: ...But what's with Haruna? Why's she dressed like that?
*At last the light was gone, leaving behind the faint purple of a dawning sky.*
*...It was a sign that at least one battle was over.*

Yamato: This is what peace feels like.
Jack: 'tis a truly wonderful thing. I've seen no sign lately of suspicious personage.
Yamato: Except for you, of course.
*We were on our way to school. I gazed at the peaceful river and breathed deeply of the clean spring air.*
*It was all over... there was no doubt about that. And yet, I couldn't escape this curious unease in my heart.*
*I could hear the sound of children playing by the riverside. That was right...*
Jack: Upon my recollection, this is the location where we first met that man, is it not?
Yamato: ...Yes.

Yamato: ...A superhero...

*I looked up at the sky, thinking back on the days we had all spent fighting.*
Yamato: Wasn't there... Wasn't there more that I could have done?
*I was grateful to have known the kind-hearted people in the apartment next door, and yet... I had also been helpless to save them.*
Jack: What troubles you, My Liege? Verily, your expression shows dissatisfaction.

Jack: The blue skies, the drifting clouds, the innocent children at play. 'tis the very world we have dreamed of!

Jack: Such dissatisfaction does not suit you.

*It was true. The sky was blue, and the clouds were high in the sky.*
*The world was at peace.*
Yamato: That... That's true.
*Even so, I had a feeling that things weren't over. There was something left for me to do.*
*Just then, in the distance, I heard the sound of sirens. It was a sign of impending crisis in the city.*
Jack: My Liege!
Yamato: Move out! It's time for Dengeki Stryker!
*Jack and I raced to the scene. We had to do this - for the man who had wished to be a hero.*
*And so, in my fight for this city, I would be that hero.*
